questions.q: In what year did the crown from Rome reach Duklja?
questions.e: In the video: "Godine 1077. iz Rima je u Duklju stigla zlatna kruna" — in 1077 a golden crown arrived in Duklja from Rome.

questions.q: Who became the first Serbian king, according to the video?
questions.e: In the video: "Mihajlo Vojislavljević postao je prvi srpski kralj" — Mihailo Vojislavljević became the first Serbian king.

questions.q: How many years, according to the video, did Byzantine rule over the Serbian coastland last?
questions.e: In the video: "Skoro pola veka" — almost half a century.

questions.q: How did Stefan Vojislav defeat the huge Byzantine army?
o: He attacked at night in the mountains, knowing the terrain well
questions.e: In the video: "A Stefan Vojislav je poznavao svaki kamen, svaki potok, svaku stazu" — and Stefan Vojislav knew every stone, every stream, every path.

questions.q: How did Mihailo differ from his father?
questions.e: In the video: "Otac je bio ratnik, Mihajlo je bio diplomata" — the father was a warrior, Mihailo was a diplomat.

questions.q: What split Christianity in two in 1054?
questions.e: In the video: "Veliki crkveni raskol iz 1054. godine podelio je hrišćanstvo" — the Great Schism of 1054 divided Christianity.
In the video: "Mihajlov sin Konstantin Bodin nastavio je očevu liniju" — Mihailo's son Konstantin Bodin continued his father's line.

questions.q: What dynasty will the next episode be about?
questions.e: In the video: "Pred Nemanjićko doba" — before the Nemanjić era.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Plemić — a nobleman, a person of high birth.
Vojska — an army.
Kruna — a crown.
Nezavisan — independent.

questions.q: Bitka se odigrala u *dolini* iznad reke.
questions.e: Dolina — a valley.
Pobeći — to run away.
Brat — a brother; braća — brothers.
Zenit — the peak, the zenith.

questions.q: Vizantija nikada nije pokušala da je ponovo ___.
questions.e: Da + present tense: da je osvoji.

questions.q: Vojska je prošla preko ___ kod Bara.
questions.e: Preko + accusative case: preko brda — "across the hills" (brda — plural of brdo).

questions.q: Stefan Vojislav je proglasio Duklju za ___ državu.
questions.e: Proglasiti za + accusative case: za nezavisnu državu.
Oženiti + accusative case: princezu.
U + accusative case (where to): u Duklju.
Instrumental case: mačem — "with a sword".
Na + accusative case: na kanal.
Accusative case, feminine: očevu liniju.
